verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens that can be scoped to restrict operations, including building a read-only integration, which implies a programmable public API. However, the pack contains no API reference itself, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths. The CLI and MCP server are separate interfaces and earn no credit here. missing for 10: a documented API reference covering endpoints and resources, a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
